title: NIST WebBook: Phosphorus is P, molecular weight 30.973762 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Phosphorus as P, molecular weight 30.973762 amu, CAS 7723-14-0.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Phosphorus, CAS Registry Number 7723-14-0, lists molecular formula P and molecular weight 30.973762 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 30.97376163 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/P. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
